name: Looker Studio (Google Data Studio)
description: Looker is a powerful business intelligence and data analytics platform that helps organizations explore, analyze, and share real-time business insights. It provides a user-friendly interface for creating data-driven reports and dashboards, enabling data teams to collaborate effectively and make informed decisions.
